passages.title: Transkrypcja nagrania do zadania 1
paragraphs: Tekst 1.
Man: Helen, we’re moving our things to the new house this afternoon.
Girl: Great. I can’t wait to arrange my new room.
Man: Today we will take your bookcase so please pack your books. And empty your
desk. Mr Jackson is going to take it for his daughter.
Girl: My pink desk?
Man: Don’t you remember? We agreed to get you a bigger one. I’ve seen some
interesting furniture for teenagers at the shop and I’m sure we’ll find something for
you there.
Girl: Great! And what about my bed?
Man: Tonight we are still sleeping in this house. We are moving our beds tomorrow.
Tekst 2.
Boy: Mum, I need your help with my project. I have to choose a picture showing a
typical English person.
Woman: Well… it’s hard because everybody’s different.
Boy: I know, but at school we are talking about European nations and their
characteristics.
Woman: Fine, let’s try then. Drinking tea at five o’clock is definitely not true anymore.
Boy: Yes, you’re right. What about taking an umbrella everywhere because it rains a lot
in England?
Woman: Well, my English friends don’t do that. I think it’s safe to say the English love pets,
so the picture with puppies is perfect.
Boy: Good point! I’ll use that one.
Tekst 3.
Man: You look sad. What’s happened?
Girl: I wanted to pay for this book but I can’t find my purse.
Man: Think where you last had it.
Girl: I remember paying for a bus ticket an hour ago.
Man: Are you sure?
Girl: Yes, I am. I think I lost it or somebody stole it then.
Man: You should report it to the police. And don’t worry. I’ll keep the book for you until
tomorrow. It costs £10.
Girl: Thanks, that’s very kind of you.
Tekst 4.
Man: Thank you for inviting me to the career day at your school. I’d like to tell you when
my passion for cooking started. One morning, when I was about seven, I went to
the garden with my mother to pick apples. Then we made a delicious pie. And that
inspired me to become a chef.
Tekst 5.
Girl: Hi Sue! Chris called me today to say sorry for not coming to my party! He offered
to help me with the geography project and invited me for a bike ride tomorrow. But
my bike’s broken. Could I use yours? Please! Call me back!

passages.title: Transkrypcja nagrania do zadania 2
paragraphs: Wypowiedź 1.
Boy: I have swimming practice, Spanish lessons and guitar lessons because my parents
organize all my free time. In the summer they take me to see interesting places so I can
learn new things. I think it’s too much. It would be nice just to stay at home and do
nothing.
Wypowiedź 2.
Girl: I play in our school band and I have lots of friends and hobbies, so I don’t often get
bored. But being bored is not so bad, at least for me. That’s when the best ideas for
new songs come into my head. When I sit in my room, doing nothing, I suddenly start
singing a new melody to myself!
Wypowiedź 3.
Boy: There are a lot of situations where you might get bored. It may be on the bus, or in the
dentist’s waiting room. Then you’ve got some time and nothing to do. That’s why
wherever I go, I have a small notebook and a pencil in my pocket. I just take them out
and start filling my notebook with funny pictures.
Wypowiedź 4.
Girl: Every time I feel bored I make lists. I write lists of things to do, lists of books to read
or films to watch. I make them because when I note something down, I remember it
better. And when I complete a task, I cross it out. That’s my way of getting things
done. It works and I enjoy it.

passages.title: Transkrypcja nagrania do zadania 3
paragraphs: Man: Visit the Gaming Festival at the Sports Arena from 29th to 31st May. What can you do
there?
If you want to test your knowledge of video games, take part in our team quiz. Your
team should have from 3 to 5 players who will have to answer a set of questions.
Would you prefer to compete on your own? There is a creative corner where you can
draw your favourite video game hero using the latest software. The best 3 will get a
prize.
But it’s not only about fun. If you are worried about the effects of video and computer
games on your health, come and talk to our expert, Professor Steve Jones. He will tell
you how your body reacts to gaming.
Tickets are available at www.londontickets.co.uk. But you should also visit
www.game.london.com where you can test new games and learn more about the
festival. See you there!

could have fun. What inspired him? 8.1. _____ Soon after receiving it, he started to design
the park.

in memory of Walt Disney, the light in his room is always on.
Finally, on July 17, 1955, the park opened to the public. Originally, it had 26 attractions.
8.4. _____ He said: “Disneyland will never be completed. It will continue to grow.”
Na podstawie: waltsdisneyland.wordpress.com

C. A little girl who wanted to meet Mickey Mouse once wrote a letter to him.
D. Soon, more were added because Disney wanted visitors to return to his park.
